runs.content: S&P Global beat Q3 and raised FY26 adj EPS, revenue and margin guidance, yet was flat on the print and sits 12.5% below its 52-week high, with >$7B of buybacks and a Capital IQ strategic review as added catalysts (ELV trimmed −4.54% for capacity).

Allegion beat Q3 (organic +7.2%, adj EPS +13%) and raised FY26 guidance; it is in a clean uptrend near its 52-week high at ~17.8x forward earnings, with no Burry overlap (RIGL hit T1 today; MCK trimmed for capacity).
